goal: Make Mission Control dramatically more visual and compact: communicate each core mission through symbol, roadmap position, one current milestone, one next win and one recent win before any prose.
constraints: Keep all core missions visible together.
Keep Mission Control read-only and public-safe.
Use restrained semantic color rather than decorative multi-color UI.
done_when: Default screen can be scanned without reading paragraphs.
Core missions fit more compactly on desktop.
Current milestone and next win are one-line dominant signals.
Legacy cyan/violet dashboard palette is removed.
uncertainties: Final aesthetic preference is human judgement; CI can protect hierarchy and palette constraints but cannot prove taste.
next_step: Run Council CI and generated Pages snapshot; merge only if the visual-density and roadmap contracts pass.
